en.text: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

zhSimplified.text: 神的灵感动俄德的儿子亚撒利雅。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的靈感動俄德的兒子亞撒利雅。

en.text: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! The LORD is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

zhSimplified.text: 他出来迎接亚撒，对他说：「亚撒和犹大、便雅悯众人哪，要听我说：你们若顺从耶和华，耶和华必与你们同在；你们若寻求他，就必寻见；你们若离弃他，他必离弃你们。

zhTraditional.text: 他出來迎接亞撒，對他說：「亞撒和猶大、便雅憫眾人哪，要聽我說：你們若順從耶和華，耶和華必與你們同在；你們若尋求他，就必尋見；你們若離棄他，他必離棄你們。

en.text: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人不信真神，没有训诲的祭司，也没有律法，已经好久了；

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人不信真神，沒有訓誨的祭司，也沒有律法，已經好久了；

en.text: But when in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

zhSimplified.text: 但他们在急难的时候归向耶和华—以色列的 神，寻求他，他就被他们寻见。

zhTraditional.text: 但他們在急難的時候歸向耶和華－以色列的上帝，尋求他，他就被他們尋見。

en.text: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，出入的人不得平安，列国的居民都遭大乱；

zhTraditional.text: 那時，出入的人不得平安，列國的居民都遭大亂；

en.text: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

zhSimplified.text: 这国攻击那国，这城攻击那城，互相破坏，因为 神用各样灾难扰乱他们。

zhTraditional.text: 這國攻擊那國，這城攻擊那城，互相破壞，因為上帝用各樣災難擾亂他們。

en.text: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在你们要刚强，不要手软，因你们所行的必得赏赐。」

zhTraditional.text: 現在你們要剛強，不要手軟，因你們所行的必得賞賜。」

en.text: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the LORD’s altar that was before the LORD’s porch.

zhSimplified.text: 亚撒听见这话和俄德儿子先知亚撒利雅的预言，就壮起胆来，在犹大、便雅悯全地，并以法莲山地所夺的各城，将可憎之物尽都除掉，又在耶和华殿的廊前重新修筑耶和华的坛；

zhTraditional.text: 亞撒聽見這話和俄德兒子先知亞撒利雅的預言，就壯起膽來，在猶大、便雅憫全地，並以法蓮山地所奪的各城，將可憎之物盡都除掉，又在耶和華殿的廊前重新修築耶和華的壇；

en.text: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

zhSimplified.text: 又招聚犹大、便雅悯的众人，并他们中间寄居的以法莲人、玛拿西人、西缅人。有许多以色列人归降亚撒，因见耶和华—他的 神与他同在。

zhTraditional.text: 又招聚猶大、便雅憫的眾人，並他們中間寄居的以法蓮人、瑪拿西人、西緬人。有許多以色列人歸降亞撒，因見耶和華－他的上帝與他同在。

en.text: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

zhSimplified.text: 亚撒十五年三月，他们都聚集在耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 亞撒十五年三月，他們都聚集在耶路撒冷。

en.text: They sacrificed to the LORD in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 当日他们从所取的掳物中，将牛七百只、羊七千只献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 當日他們從所取的擄物中，將牛七百隻、羊七千隻獻給耶和華。

en.text: They entered into the covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

zhSimplified.text: 他们就立约，要尽心尽性地寻求耶和华—他们列祖的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就立約，要盡心盡性地尋求耶和華－他們列祖的上帝。

en.text: and that whoever would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

zhSimplified.text: 凡不寻求耶和华—以色列 神的，无论大小、男女，必被治死。

zhTraditional.text: 凡不尋求耶和華－以色列上帝的，無論大小、男女，必被治死。

en.text: They swore to the LORD with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就大声欢呼，吹号吹角，向耶和华起誓。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就大聲歡呼，吹號吹角，向耶和華起誓。

en.text: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then the LORD gave them rest all around.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大众人为所起的誓欢喜；因他们是尽心起誓，尽意寻求耶和华，耶和华就被他们寻见，且赐他们四境平安。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大眾人為所起的誓歡喜；因他們是盡心起誓，盡意尋求耶和華，耶和華就被他們尋見，且賜他們四境平安。

en.text: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

zhSimplified.text: 亚撒王贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，捣得粉碎，烧在汲沦溪边。

zhTraditional.text: 亞撒王貶了他祖母瑪迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亞舍拉。亞撒砍下她的偶像，搗得粉碎，燒在汲淪溪邊。

en.text: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

zhSimplified.text: 只是邱坛还没有从以色列中废去，然而亚撒的心一生诚实。

zhTraditional.text: 只是邱壇還沒有從以色列中廢去，然而亞撒的心一生誠實。

en.text: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 亚撒将他父所分别为圣、与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到 神的殿里。

zhTraditional.text: 亞撒將他父所分別為聖、與自己所分別為聖的金銀和器皿都奉到上帝的殿裏。

en.text: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

zhSimplified.text: 从这时直到亚撒三十五年，都没有争战的事。

zhTraditional.text: 從這時直到亞撒三十五年，都沒有爭戰的事。
